rule: TypeScript-only: a successful stream requires response.completed, whose output_text overrides partial deltas. SSE error codes usage_not_included and rate_limit_exceeded preserve their kinds even when messages are generic. A stream may carry tool calls: response.function_call_arguments.delta deltas accumulate per output item, response.output_item.done carries each finished item, and response.completed.response.output is the authoritative item list. Items without output_text contribute no text.
